items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: "All these guys are my teachers, you know?" Chick Corea, you know. And all of it rubs off on you if you listen, you know?

ctx.x: Yeah. No, Andy Razaf was the one -- we were paying a visit to him out here. He lived on Country Club Drive, and I think he was in a wheelchair by then, you know. And he was talking to me and talking to Speedy, you know, and then his wife, and he was telling me about it. Speedy didn't know. She didn't even know herself, you know. Fats used to go by, you know. I met Fats in Chicago once, and I used to idolize him. Well, he was one of the finest piano players that I knew, along with the history -- I think the…
You told me that in between interviews here (Inaudible), you overdubbed some music with Jimmy Smith the organ player...
